title: Polynomial bounds under a power transformation
statement: Let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be polynomially bounded, and let $a,d \in \mathbb{N}$. Then the function $n \mapsto a(f(n)+1)^d$ is polynomially bounded.
replaced: If a numerical function $f$ is polynomially bounded, then for all constants $a$ and $d$ the function $n \mapsto a(f(n)+1)^d$ is polynomially bounded; a size estimate is not thereby turned into a machine clock.
